name: Fortune and Glory
description: Fortune and Glory was the personal Luxury 3000 space yacht of the pirate Captain Hondo Ohnaka, leader of the Ohnaka Gang. He used the yacht to deliver supplies to a group of rebels on the planet Onderon during the Onderonian Civil War in the Clone Wars. When Ohnaka and his gang were forced to flee their base on the planet Florrum, they left the vessel behind in Hondo's secret ship vault.
